non_repeating.method: Normalised cross-correlation of 2 in patches (high-passed luminance, half resolution) against every window of the whole atlas on the torus, 8 dihedral transforms, windows touching joints or chiseled faces ignored; whole-face NCC of every matte pair and raw pair under the 12 hexagon symmetries. Chiseled faces are not covered (their grooves repeat by design and the grain is under the grooves); see README.
non_repeating.reading: No patch or face matched above NCC 0.50; the source render's own unique faces reach 0.68 under the same search. The 0.4-0.5 matches are consistent with source library blocks being reused (about 1.4x reuse was unavoidable; the face 42 / face 25 pair visibly shares a dark micro-mark after contrast stretching, see _REVIEW_repeat_top_matches.jpg) and are not visible in the unstretched colour map; a planted copy degraded by noise 2x the patch std scores 0.44-0.46, so matches near 0.5 cannot be separated from a heavily degraded copy by this test alone.

chiseled_groove_check.method: FFT peak (5x5 power-weighted centroid) of a 384 px window at each chiseled face centre in Color.png, band period 8-22 px; angle is the groove wave-vector angle in image coordinates (0 = vertical grooves)
